	end;

	mes "[Inn Employee]";
	mes "A night's rest is ^0000FF5,000 zeny^000000. I'll also note this inn as your return point.";

	if (@menu == 2) {
		savepoint "jalbe_in",32,142,1,1;
		mes "Saved. You'll return here.";
		close;
	}
	if (Zeny < 5000) {
		mes "You don't have enough zeny.";
		close;
	}
	Zeny -= 5000;
	percentheal 100,100;
	savepoint "jalbe_in",32,142,1,1;
	mes "Sleep well. You're fully rested, and you'll return here.";
	close;
}

pay_mk,133,163,4	script	Storage Locker#ws29252	10249,{
	mes "[Storage Locker]";
	mes "Storage is ^0000FF40 zeny^000000.";
	if (select("Open storage:Cancel") == 2) close;
	if (Zeny < 40) {
		mes "You don't have enough zeny.";
		close;
	}
	Zeny -= 40;
	close2;
	openstorage;
	end;
}

	end;

ygg_edge,202,204,4	script	Repairman#ws19908	86,{
	mes "[Repairman]";

	end;
